captions.OPEN: Home: arms open (20°). The can stands against the silicone bumper.
captions.GRIP: GRIP: SG90 turns 20° → 95°. It drives the LEFT arm; the gears turn the RIGHT arm the same amount the other way.
captions.HOLD: Holding: pads squeeze ~0.5–1 N per arm (holds 15 g; dents at ~8 N).
captions.RELEASE: RELEASE: 95° → 70°, only 25° (upside down at the target, a full opening would hit the base).
captions.HOLD2: Pads now clear the can by ~2 mm.
